Name: Radovan Jankovic
Description: Radovan Jankovic runs his club VS. in New York where thugs, criminals, and no goods come to make bets on super powered fights or to watch superheroes bleed. Radovan is also the brother-in-law to the Bank a renown money launderer for criminals. After the Punisher invaded his club he sold out the Bank in exchange for his life.
